t: 英国广播公司(后为公司)由财团成立,以建立全国性的无线电发射台网络来提供全国性的广播服务.

dz: 英国广播公司(后为公司)由财团成立,以建立全国性的无线电发射台网络来提供全国性的广播服务.
de: The British Broadcasting Company (later Corporation)  is founded by a consortium, to establish a nationwide network of radio transmitters to provide a national broadcasting service.

t: 英国保守党议员投票终止与自由党的联合政府.
te: British Conservative MPs vote to terminate the coalition government with the Liberal Party.
dz: 英国保守党议员投票终止与自由党的联合政府.
de: British Conservative MPs vote to terminate the coalition government with the Liberal Party.

t: 罗得西亚的全民公投拒绝该国吞并南非.
te: A referendum in Rhodesia rejects the country's annexation to the South African Union.
dz: 罗得西亚的全民公投拒绝该国吞并南非.
de: A referendum in Rhodesia rejects the country's annexation to the South African Union.

te: Italian fascists led by Benito Mussolini march on Rome and take over the Italian government.
dz: 由贝尼托·墨索里尼所领导的意大利法西斯主义者向罗马出征并占领了意大利政府.
de: Italian fascists led by Benito Mussolini march on Rome and take over the Italian government.

te: Benito Mussolini is made Prime Minister of Italy.
dz: 贝尼托·墨索里尼就任意大利总理。
de: Benito Mussolini is made Prime Minister of Italy.

t: 奥斯曼帝国最后一位苏丹,迈赫梅德六世,退位.
te: The last sultan of the Ottoman Empire, Mehmed VI, abdicates.
dz: 废除奥斯曼苏丹国:奥斯曼帝国最后一位苏丹,迈赫梅德六世,退位.
de: Abolition of the Ottoman sultanate: The last sultan of the Ottoman Empire, Mehmed VI, abdicates.

dz: 在埃及,英国考古学家霍华德·卡特和他的手下在国王之谷发现了图坦卡蒙墓的出入口.
de: In Egypt, British archaeologist Howard Carter and his men find the entrance to Tutankhamun's tomb in the Valley of the Kings.

te: The United States Supreme Court upholds mandatory vaccinations for public school students in Zucht v. King.
dz: 美国最高法院在 Zucht v. King 案中支持公立学校学生强制接种疫苗。
de: The United States Supreme Court upholds mandatory vaccinations for public school students in Zucht v. King.

t: 英国广播公司开始在英国提供无线电服务.
te: The British Broadcasting Company begins radio service in the United Kingdom.
dz: 英国广播公司开始在英国提供无线电服务.
de: The British Broadcasting Company begins radio service in the United Kingdom.

t: 在厄瓜多尔瓜亚基尔的一次总罢工中,至少有300人被屠杀.
te: At least 300 are massacred during a general strike in Guayaquil, Ecuador.
dz: 在厄瓜多尔瓜亚基尔的一次总罢工中,至少有300人被屠杀.
de: At least 300 are massacred during a general strike in Guayaquil, Ecuador.

t: 佐治亚州丽贝卡·拉蒂默·费尔顿宣誓就职,成为美国首位女性参议员.
te: Rebecca Latimer Felton of Georgia takes the oath of office, becoming the first female United States Senator.
dz: 佐治亚州丽贝卡·拉蒂默·费尔顿宣誓就职,成为美国首位女性参议员.
de: Rebecca Latimer Felton of Georgia takes the oath of office, becoming the first female United States Senator.

t: 9名爱尔兰共和军成员被爱尔兰自由邦行刑队处决. 其中有作者Erskine Childers, …
te: Nine Irish Republican Army members are executed by an Irish Free State firing squad. Among them is author Erskine Child…
dz: 9名爱尔兰共和军成员被爱尔兰自由邦行刑队处决. 其中有作者Erskine Childers, 他因非法携带左轮手枪而被捕.
de: Nine Irish Republican Army members are executed by an Irish Free State firing squad. Among them is author Erskine Childers, who had been arrested for illegally carrying a revolver.

t: 霍华德·卡特和卡纳尔冯勋爵成为了3000多年以来第一个进入法老图坦卡蒙坟墓的人.
te: Howard Carter and Lord Carnarvon become the first people to enter the tomb of Pharaoh Tutankhamun in over 3,000 years.
dz: 霍华德·卡特和卡纳尔冯勋爵成为了3000多年以来第一个进入法老图坦卡蒙坟墓的人.
de: Howard Carter and Lord Carnarvon become the first people to enter the tomb of Pharaoh Tutankhamun in over 3,000 years.

t: "出海之道"作为第一部使用"双通"Technicolor的一般出道影片. ("海湾之间"是第一…
te: The Toll of the Sea debuts as the first general release film to use two-tone Technicolor. (The Gulf Between was the fir…
dz: "出海之道"作为第一部使用"双通"Technicolor的一般出道影片. ("海湾之间"是第一部这样做的电影,但并没有被广泛发行. )
de: The Toll of the Sea debuts as the first general release film to use two-tone Technicolor. (The Gulf Between was the first film to do so, but it was not widely distributed.)

t: 《英爱条约》签署整整一年后，爱尔兰被分治，北爱尔兰与爱尔兰自由邦随之成立。
te: Ireland is partitioned, with Northern Ireland and the Irish Free State coming into existence, one year to the day after…
dz: 《英爱条约》签署整整一年后，爱尔兰被分治，北爱尔兰与爱尔兰自由邦随之成立。
de: Ireland is partitioned, with Northern Ireland and the Irish Free State coming into existence, one year to the day after the signing of the Anglo-Irish Treaty.

t: 北爱尔兰议会投票决定保留为英国的一部分,不与南爱尔兰统一.
te: The Parliament of Northern Ireland votes to remain a part of the United Kingdom and not unify with Southern Ireland.
dz: 北爱尔兰议会投票决定保留为英国的一部分,不与南爱尔兰统一.
de: The Parliament of Northern Ireland votes to remain a part of the United Kingdom and not unify with Southern Ireland.

t: 迪克·巴雷特,乔·麦克凯尔维,利亚姆·梅卢斯和罗里·奥康纳.
te: Two days after coming into existence, the Irish Free State executes four leaders of the Irish Republican Army: Dick Bar…
dz: 成立后两天,爱尔兰自由邦处决了爱尔兰共和军的四名领导人:迪克·巴雷特,乔·麦克凯尔维,利亚姆·梅卢斯和罗里·奥康纳.
de: Two days after coming into existence, the Irish Free State executes four leaders of the Irish Republican Army:  Dick Barrett, Joe McKelvey, Liam Mellows and Rory O'Connor.

t: 加布里埃尔·纳鲁托维奇被选为波兰首任总统.
te: Gabriel Narutowicz is elected the first president of Poland.
dz: 加布里埃尔·纳鲁托维奇被选为波兰首任总统.
de: Gabriel Narutowicz is elected the first president of Poland.

dz: 日本航空母舰“凤翔”号成为世界上第一艘服役的专用航空母舰。
de: Japanese aircraft carrier Hōshō becomes the first purpose-built aircraft carrier to be commissioned in the world.

t: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟成立.

dz: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟成立.
